Thie tradition is all over the Amazon jungle to survive. The hunted food are high in the canopy so they need the poison arrow technic. The drink - Kashiri or Masato or Casha-Casha is made in tree trunk s and left fermented after the Casava / Yuca is chewed for several days [minimal 4 d] Qua hygiene depends your opinion. Human saliva has enzymes yo break down starch, basic pH and also Lysozyme our natural antibiotic. Some mothers feed their children with the mothers chewed food before becoming independent eating normal food. So the Masato is technically clean from mold and sicknesses. The Yuca must be peeled. washed and cooked to get rid from its poisonous -cyanide. Raw consumption is deadly.
The Yuca is also bake into bread after rasping the raw yuca and washing the pulp with clean water for several ours. The pulp free of the cyanogenic glycosides, are baked into flat bread [available in Amazon]
